newsitem.title: USA: Wireless One falls on forecast of losses.
newsitem.headline: Wireless One falls on forecast of losses.

text.p: Wireless One Inc shares fell over 20 percent after the company said it expects to continue posting losses.

In its third quarter earnings release, the company said it "expects to continue experiencing consolidated net losses and negative EBITDA due to extensive operating, selling, general and administrative expenses and capital expenditures required during the rapid expansion phase of its business plan."
Shares fell 2-3/4 to 9-1/4 and hit a new 52-week low of 7-3/4 during intraday trading.
Wireless One posted a net loss for the third quarter of 1996 of $0.64 per share compared to a net loss of $0.72 per share for the third quarter of 1995.
